items.summary: We are excited to announce PHP Conference Kansai 2026! 🎉 About the conference PHP Conference Kansai is a technical conference where PHP engineers in the Kansai region of Japan share their knowledge and experience.

items.summary: The PHP development team announces the immediate availability of PHP 8.6.0. This release marks a major update to the PHP language.
